bios: Former farmhand from Nebraska. Misses the cornfields.
Worked on a Ford assembly line in Detroit.
Drafted immediately after Pearl Harbor.
Sole survivor of a training accident in basic.
Hunter from the Appalachians. Excellent shot.
University mathematics professor. Over-analyzes orders.
Ex-bootlegger who drove rum during Prohibition.
Lied about his age to enlist. He is only 17.
Semi-pro baseball pitcher. Can throw a grenade 60 yards.
Jazz pianist from New Orleans. Keeps morale high.
Son of a Senator. Trying to prove he isn't soft.
Former boxer with a broken nose and a heavy swing.
Worked as a coal miner. Not afraid of the dark.
Quiet man. Sends all his pay home to his mother.
Mechanic from Chicago. claims he can fix anything.
Gambler who owes money to the wrong people back home.
Eagle Scout. Knows every knot in the book.
Writes poetry in his trench when no one is looking.
Used to be a butcher. Handle with care.
Just wants to get this over with and go home.
Married a very famous singer.
